34d3b4ab: What is Gon Freecss's goal in Hunter × Hunter?
Gon is looking for his father Ging Freecss, a legendary Hunter who left him behind when he was a baby.
a7702799: What is the name of the power system in Hunter × Hunter?
Nen is the life energy (aura) that Hunters learn to manipulate, divided into 6 distinct types.
19f373d2: Gon is an Enhancer, the most straightforward type, which strengthens physical abilities to the maximum.
f9558108: Killua is a Transmuter, which lets him give his aura the properties of electricity (Godspeed).
c176f1e8: Hisoka is a Transmuter who gives his aura the properties of gum (Bungee Gum).
c67c58c7: What is Hisoka's unique Nen ability called?
Bungee Gum is Hisoka's ability. It has the properties of both rubber and gum.
a0520d98: Which clan of assassins does Killua come from?
The Zoldyck family is the most feared family of assassins in the world. Killua is its most talented member.
6bc61b18: What is the first phase of the Hunter Exam?
The first phase of the Hunter Exam is an endless marathon through tunnels, testing endurance and resilience.
b70b0b3f: What is the name of the main antagonist of the Chimera Ant arc?
Meruem is the Chimera Ant King, a being born to dominate humanity who discovers empathy through Komugi.
ab16b81a: Which game does Komugi play against Meruem?
Komugi is a world champion of Gungi, a fictional strategy game. Her games against Meruem change him profoundly.
ba7b6507: What is the name of Killua's little sister?
Alluka Zoldyck carries a mysterious entity called Nanika. She can grant any wish.
03fe4bc2: What is the name of the entity inside Alluka?
Nanika is an entity of unknown origin living in Alluka's body. It grants wishes but imposes increasingly dangerous conditions.
2204bbf4: What is the name of the mountain where the Zoldycks live?
Kukuroo Mountain is the Zoldyck family's private estate, with its guard dog Mike.
b86d772b: What is the name of the criminal group in the Yorknew City arc?
The Genei Ryodan, or Phantom Troupe, is a group of 13 elite criminals led by Chrollo Lucilfer.
62918fd3: How many members does the Phantom Troupe have?
The Phantom Troupe has 13 numbered members, with Chrollo as No. 0. Each member has a spider tattoo.
e1cb7305: What is Kurapika's Specialist Nen ability?
Emperor Time gives him 100% access to every Nen type, at the cost of losing 1 hour of life for every second it is used.
498c1c3b: Leorio is an Emitter. His technique lets him throw a punch through a portal across a long distance.
b28f7267: What is Leorio's goal in the series?
Leorio wants to become a doctor to treat sick people who have no money, in memory of his friend Pietro, who died for lack of care.
4e167660: What is the name of Chrollo Lucilfer's Nen ability?
Skill Hunter lets Chrollo steal other people's Nen abilities and use them through his book.
78407c7b: What is the arc set on a ship bound for the Dark Continent called?
The Succession War arc, still ongoing, takes place aboard the Black Whale, the ship heading for the Dark Continent.
94abc3ce: What is the name of the mysterious continent of the final arc?
The Dark Continent is a mysterious land beyond the known borders, inhabited by unknown creatures.
7b3f0b3a: Ging Freecss is a Double Star Hunter, one of the five best Hunters in the world and Gon's absent father.
55bd33af: What is the rare video game Gon looks for to find his father?
Greed Island is a real video game that players physically enter. Ging created it.
87213972: What is Feitan's (Phantom Troupe) Nen type?
Feitan is a Transmuter. His ability “Pain Packer” turns all the pain he has suffered into a devastating attack.
bc5b2415: What is the golden rule of Nen regarding restrictions?
The stricter the restriction, the stronger the power
The harsher the constraints and vows a user imposes on themselves, the more their Nen ability is amplified.
8b0ba0c8: What is the name of the Hunter Association Chairman's secretary, who handles the exams' logistics?
Beans is the Chairman's secretary and Hanzo is an applicant. Netero chairs the Hunter Association.
d038e2f2: What is the name of Pouf's technique that reads emotions?
Pouf's Spiritual Message lets him read other people's emotions through particles he scatters in the air.
301949f1: What is the full name of the Chairman of the Hunter Association?
Isaac Netero is the Chairman of the Hunter Association and the most powerful Nen user of his time.
48e8f465: What is Netero's ultimate technique against Meruem called?
Zero Hand is Netero's ultimate attack: he pours all his aura into a single blow against Meruem.
b1d1a7b6: Which bomb does Netero set off on himself to defeat Meruem?
The Poor Man's Rose is a miniature bomb hidden in Netero's body. Its explosion spreads a poison that eventually kills Meruem.
3199e24c: What is the name of the city in the Yorknew arc?
Yorknew City is a global metropolis, site of the great annual auction where Kurapika hunts the Troupe.
d4e048a9: What is Illumi Zoldyck's Nen type?
Illumi is a Manipulator: he plants needles in his targets to control them like puppets.
242b5762: Illumi uses needles to manipulate brains and bodies, controlling people like puppets.
ab8c9bfd: What color do Kurapika's eyes turn when he uses his full potential?
When Kurapika's Scarlet Eyes activate, his eyes turn blood red, a sign of his maximum potential.
6ef2f324: What is the name of the royal family in the Succession War arc?
The Hui Guo Rou family is the royal family of the Kakin Empire. Its princes fight over the throne in the succession war.
2575fb27: What is the maximum number of stars a Hunter can earn?
A Hunter can earn up to 3 stars for their achievements and contributions: Single, Double and Triple Star Hunters.
e64b6e9b: What does the term “Zetsu” mean in Nen?
Completely blocking the release of aura
Zetsu means closing off the body's aura nodes to stop releasing aura and become undetectable.
74157e4d: What is the name of Knuckle's Nen technique that accumulates interest?
Hakoware (APR) lends aura with interest. If the debt exceeds the target's total aura, they lose their Nen for 30 days.
e1067305: What is the name of Knov's technique that creates dimensional portals?
Hide and Seek is Knov's technique — it creates dimensional portals to a storage space, ideal for silent infiltrations.
203d54dc: What is Ging Freecss's real goal in the latest arc?
Ging joins Beyond Netero's expedition to the Dark Continent — his true motive remains a mystery, true to his secretive character.
c89cd8a1: What is Killua's ultimate lightning-based form called?
Godspeed is Killua's ultimate form — he turns his aura into pure electricity and moves at the speed of lightning, beyond human perception.
9fd28383: Silva Zoldyck is Killua's father and the current head of the family of assassins.
9ea1ce76: What is the name of Shalnark's technique that controls humans?
Black Voice is Shalnark's technique — by sticking antennas into people, he controls them completely like puppets.
6fc75658: Which of Gon's techniques uses rock, paper, scissors?
Jajanken is Gon's technique — Rock (a concentrated punch), Scissors (cutting aura fingers), Paper (a ranged blast of aura).
5c504e2a: What is the name of Kurapika's deadly technique against the Troupe?
Judgment Chain wraps around the target's heart — if they break Kurapika's conditions, the chain tightens and kills them instantly.
30a58bfa: What is the name of the basic Nen training technique for keeping your aura in place?
Ten is the first fundamental technique — keeping your aura flowing around your body, the basis of all Nen training.
ba370f44: Who becomes Chairman of the Hunter Association after Netero?
Cheadle Yorkshire becomes chairman after Netero — but Pariston first wins the election and then immediately resigns.
527f3833: What is the technique that extends your aura over a distance called?
En is the aura extension technique — the user expands their Ten into a sphere to sense anything that enters its radius.
d6376a74: Who voices Gon in the Japanese anime?
Megumi Han voices Gon in Madhouse's 2011 anime — she energetically brings out the character's naive optimism.
f984c27f: Who is the author of the Hunter × Hunter manga?
Yoshihiro Togashi, already the author of Yu Yu Hakusho, has published Hunter × Hunter since 1998, with long breaks.
55cd17c1: Which studio produced the 2011 Hunter × Hunter anime?
Madhouse produced the 2011 version, in 148 episodes. Nippon Animation had made the first adaptation, in 1999.
0d097c90: How many episodes does the 2011 Hunter × Hunter anime have?
The 2011 series has 148 episodes and goes up to the end of the Election arc.
ed14002e: On which island did Gon grow up?
Gon grew up on Whale Island, raised by his aunt Mito.
9489ce41: Who raised Gon on his island?
Mito, Ging's cousin, raised Gon as her own son, together with her grandmother.
76150117: Which weapon does Killua use at the start of the series?
Killua fights with very heavy yo-yos. Illumi uses needles and Hisoka uses cards.
1c5656a9: Which clan does Kurapika belong to?
Kurapika is the last survivor of the Kurta clan, massacred by the Phantom Troupe for their scarlet eyes.
8e5626d2: What condition does Kurapika impose on himself for his Chain Jail?
Use it only once a day
Use it only against the Phantom Troupe, or die
Close his eyes to use it
Kurapika vows to use this chain only against members of the Phantom Troupe. This constraint multiplies its power.
415210dd: How many floors does Heavens Arena, the fighting tower of the arc of the same name, have?
Heavens Arena has 251 floors. Gon and Killua climb its ranks and discover Nen there.
e184a070: Who teaches Gon and Killua the basics of Nen at Heavens Arena?
Wing, together with his student Zushi, introduces Gon and Killua to Nen.
b337e456: Who trains Gon and Killua during the Greed Island arc?
Biscuit Krueger, a Hunter who looks like a child but is very old, trains the two boys hard on Greed Island.
6723a313: What tattoo do the members of the Phantom Troupe have?
Each member has a twelve-legged spider with their number. The group is in fact nicknamed “the Spiders”.
50780502: Which of Meruem's Royal Guards attacks Kite?
Neferpitou kills Kite, then turns his body into a puppet. This loss devastates Gon.
564db06a: Kite is Ging's disciple. He is the one who saved young Gon in the forest.
825f596c: What is the name of the entrance to the Zoldyck estate, which weighs several tons?
The Testing Gate has seven doors, each heavier than the last. Only those who can push it open are deemed worthy of entering.
73bc35ee: What is the name of Killua's mother?
Kikyo Zoldyck, always masked and wearing a visor, is Killua's mother.
